language_rules.evidence: SKKU requires at least one of the following language requirements (Language test scores must be valid) : 1) TOPIK (Test of Proficiency in Korean) level 3 or above

language_rules.note: SLI or other university-affiliated language institutes in Korea; same caveat as above
language_rules.evidence: 2) Completed Korean course level 3 or above in SLI (Sungkyun Language Institute) or other university affiliated language institutes in Korea
